title: Lula Officially Launches 2026 Reelection Campaign Targeting Working-Class Voters
detail: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva officially launched his 2026 reelection campaign, centering the bid on winning back working-class voters for the Workers' Party ahead of the October elections. The campaign launch marks a pivotal moment in Brazil's electoral cycle as Lula seeks a fourth presidential term.
